content: qemu -M virt is the best aarch64 machine for Plan 9 bring-up: 9front sys/src/9/arm64/ contains CONF=qemu, a working reference kernel for exactly that machine (PL011 UART at phys 0x09000000, GIC, virtio-1.0 pci/mmio via ethervirtio10/sdvirtio10/pciqemu/uartqemu, DTB at 0x40000000, kzero 0xffffffff80000000, loadaddr 0xffffffffc0100000, kernel wrapped to u-boot uImage by sys/src/cmd/aux/aout2uimage.c for qemu -kernel). raspi3b machine instead matches 9front bcm64 (pi3/pi4 CONFs, BCM2835 peripherals, Pi-firmware spin tables) and is only useful to run bcm64-derived kernels. Verified by direct fetch of mkfile/CONF/mem.h/uartqemu.c.
